description: This file contains functions to interact with a 'residents' database via the Supabase client, providing features to fetch multiple residents with search, pagination, and sorting, as well as fetching a single resident by ID.

methods.name: fetchResidents({ search = '', page = 1, pageSize = 12, sort = 'name.asc' } = {})
methods.description: Fetches a paginated list of residents with optional search and sorting parameters.

methods.name: fetchResidentById(id)
methods.description: Fetches a single resident record by its unique ID.

ctags.name: fetchResidents
ctags.pattern: /^export async function fetchResidents({ search = '', page = 1, pageSize = 12, sort = 'name.asc' }/
